{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hom Mounds''' were a ceremonial [[Nociv]] burial site located in the hills of [[Kadril]]. The Nocivs believed by buried their dead in the Hom Mounds, the dead were able to return to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from which all life stemmed. During the interment the deceased Nociv was placed on a mound, allowing the body to be absorbed into the ground.
